# Matr Studio

> A curated index of design resources for UX and product designers.

Matr Studio (resources.matrstudio.com) is a library of handpicked tools, articles, books, videos, templates, podcasts, and courses — organized by design topic. It covers design execution, strategic thinking, business & growth, and career development for designers.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://resources.matrstudio.com) — Browse all resources
- [Topics](https://resources.matrstudio.com/topics) — Browse resources by topic
- [Submit a Resource](https://resources.matrstudio.com/submit) — Submit a resource for review

## Design Topics

### Design Execution
Resources on translating design decisions into high-quality, consistent output.
- [Design Systems](https://resources.matrstudio.com/topics/design-systems)
- [Design Handoff](https://resources.matrstudio.com/topics/design-handoff)
- [Prototyping](https://resources.matrstudio.com/topics/prototyping)
- [Documentation](https://resources.matrstudio.com/topics/documentation)
- [Visual Architecture](https://resources.matrstudio.com/topics/visual-architecture)

Resources on thinking beyond the screen — from research to rationale.
- [Design Rationale](https://resources.matrstudio.com/topics/design-rationale)
- [Stakeholder Management](https://resources.matrstudio.com/topics/stakeholder-management)

- [User Research](https://resources.matrstudio.com/topics/user-research)

Resources on the intersection of design, product, and business outcomes.

### Career & Craft
Resources on building a sustainable, high-leverage design career.

## Resource Types

Matr Studio indexes the following resource formats: Articles, Videos, Books, Tools, Courses, Templates, Podcasts.

## About

Matr Studio is created and maintained by the Matr Studio team. Resources are curated and reviewed before being added to the index. Designers can submit resources for consideration at https://resources.matrstudio.com/submit.
